messages.content: {"spec_element":"invariant","proof_obligation":"preservation","diagnosis":"In the PositiveSet.find method, the loop invariant 0 <= i <= nelems is missing. The Set class's find has this invariant, but PositiveSet's find only has invariant forall j::(0<=j< i) ==> x != store[j]. Without 0 <= i, after the first iteration (where i := i + 1), Dafny cannot prove that store[i] is a valid index on subsequent iterations, because it no longer knows i >= 0. The counterexample (nelems=610, store.Length=610, i=0) confirms the access to store[i] fails the bounds check.","repair":"invariant 0 <= i <= nelems"}

attempts.diagnosis: In the PositiveSet.find method, the loop invariant 0 <= i <= nelems is missing. The Set class's find has this invariant, but PositiveSet's find only has invariant forall j::(0<=j< i) ==> x != store[j]. Without 0 <= i, after the first iteration (where i := i + 1), Dafny cannot prove that store[i] is a valid index on subsequent iterations, because it no longer knows i >= 0. The counterexample (nelems=610, store.Length=610, i=0) confirms the access to store[i] fails the bounds check.
